artifact: §21 — the three fragments previously adjudicated PLAUSIBLE_REVIEW, classified rather than blessed

fragments.fragment: "The Applicable Margin for any day shall be"
fragments.why: the frozen contract permits child descent only for a lead-in that is POSITIVELY nothing but a subordinating connective. This fragment names the subject, a temporal qualifier and the operative verb; every enumerated child states only a rate and a ratio test. Descent would discard the subject of the whole grid.
'solely if X' is a strictly narrower proposition than 'if X'. An exclusivity qualifier is content, not glue, and it is not in the closed connective class.

fragments.fragment: "The Borrower will furnish to the Administrative Agent:"
fragments.why: carries obligor, obligation verb and recipient; the children carry only deadlines and deliverables.

specificationChangeRequired: NONE. The frozen source-coverage contract already decides all three the same way, and it decides them correctly.
actionTaken: stale expectations corrected as in §20; no production change.
